excludedScope: Specific disease, treatment, diagnosis, or an individual bodily state are outside this Article.
MULTI_ASSET production, CAR brief, and publication authority remain outside C2.
includedScope: Bodily layers, Carrier interfaces, resource limits, Feedback, and recovery boundaries.

mustEstablish.requirement: The body consists of multiple interdependent but non-interchangeable Carrier layers.
Boundaries, exchange, regulation, and Feedback connect the layers.
Capacity, speed, resources, and recovery limits shape the states a Carrier can sustain.
Bodily limitation is not Identity, moral value, or personal failure.

mustNotClaim: Do not claim that any single bodily layer completely determines consciousness, Identity, or behavior.
Do not interpret capacity limits as moral, willpower, or personality defects.
Do not provide medical, psychological, nutritional, or health advice.
Do not turn Legacy Supporting evidence into Canonical Thesis.
Do not create cross-node Asset assembly at C2.
requiredDistinctions: Layer dependence is not single-layer determinism.
A general Runtime mechanism is not a medical fact or diagnosis.
Finitude is not a defect-value judgment.
A C2 knowledge boundary is not the historical KPP MULTI_ASSET projection.

canonicalMeaning.canonicalQuestion: Why Does the Body Function as a Layered and Finite Reality Carrier?
canonicalMeaning.canonicalTitle: Why Is the Body a Layered and Finite Reality Carrier?
canonicalMeaning.centralThesis: The body is a layered and finite Reality Carrier because ongoing Runtime depends on interacting material, regulatory, sensation-action, resource, and recovery boundaries. These layers depend on one another without any single layer representing Identity or determining the whole person.
